licence.grants_our_words: Personal-use copies, with the notice kept on. Educators and in-house trainers may copy for their students. A named exception lets design teams doing heuristic evaluation, cognitive walkthrough or day-to-day design work reproduce enough copies for the team, commercial or not.
licence.forbids_our_words: Republishing on a web site, publishing in bound form, or making multiple copies outside the exceptions requires contacting the author; any commercial use beyond the exceptions needs permission; the notice must travel with any version of the work.

permits_us: names-only for node text (the 20 principle NAMES + pointer). Internal team copies of the whole article are inside the design-work exception with the notice retained. Emitting the article's sentences into generated client deliverables is republication for money and is NOT covered.
why_our_words: The exception is generous to a design team using the principles, and R1's own-words rows are exactly that use. But the generation chain emits text into a commercial bank's assets, which is the 'publishing it for money' the author's aside at line 848 excludes. So: names and pointers in the graph, the article on the team's shelf, and one email if Dave wants more.
cheap_route_to_lift: The notice invites it: 'Please contact the author for permission to republish' — one message via the page's mailer link (http://www.asktog.com/misc/mailer.html). Price: one email; a written yes would lift this family to reproduce-with-notice.
unproven: Whether Apollo's KG node text counts as 'republish on a web site' or as 'day-to-day design work' — the notice was written for human readers and does not contemplate a generator; this lane takes the conservative reading and flags the question for Dave.

pitfalls.what: The design-work exception is easy to over-read as a general commercial licence. It covers copies FOR THE TEAM carrying out the work, not text emitted TO CLIENTS.
The notice must be retained with any version of the work — if any excerpt beyond a ≤15-word quote ever enters an asset, the whole notice travels with it or the grant lapses.
